shortDescription: Remote Support Contact operations on a PowerStore storage system

options.name: array_ip
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerStore management system.

options.name: contact_id
options.description: Unique identifier of the remote support contact.

options.name: email
options.description: The email address of the support contact for this system.

options.name: first_name
options.description: The first name of the support contact for this system.

options.name: last_name
options.description: The last name of the support contact for this system.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerStore host.

options.name: phone
options.description: The phone number of this support contact for this system.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number for the PowerStore array. If not passed, it will take 443 as default.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the remote support contact after the task is performed. For Delete operation only, it should be set to C(absent). For get/modify operation it should be set to C(present).

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the PowerStore host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. Set the environment variable REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE to the path of the SSL certificate. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
